title: Maximum Array Hopping Score II
description:
Given an array `nums`, you have to get the **maximum** score starting from index 0 and **hopping** until you reach the last element of the array.

In each **hop**, you can jump from index `i` to an index `j > i`, and you get a **score** of `(j - i) * nums[j]`.

Return the *maximum score* you can get.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Maximum Array Hopping Score II.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
